summary: On node1 (AlmaLinux 9), installed the dnf versionlock plugin and locked curl at its currently installed version (curl-7.76.1-31.el9). Verified the hold by running a real `dnf update -y` that upgraded 224 packages including a new kernel and libcurl (7.76.1-40.el9_8.5) while curl itself stayed pinned at 7.76.1-31.el9. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, issued `systemctl reboot`, confirmed boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, now running kernel 5.14.0-687.42.1), and confirmed the system returned to healthy state (systemctl is-system-running: running, 0 failed units) with the curl versionlock rule and pinned version intact post-reboot.
actions_performed: Checked current curl version on node1 (curl-7.76.1-31.el9.x86_64)
Ran `dnf versionlock add curl` to pin curl to its installed version
Confirmed via `dnf update --assumeno` dry run that curl was excluded from a 207-package pending update set
Executed a real `dnf update -y` (224 packages incl. new kernel and libcurl) in background and polled it to completion
Verified curl version unchanged post-update while libcurl and other packages upgraded
Captured baseline boot_id, uptime, and system health before restart
Issued `systemctl reboot` on node1 and confirmed acknowledgement returned
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id changed and new kernel (5.14.0-687.42.1.el9_8) is running, confirming genuine restart
Verified system health (systemctl is-system-running: running, no failed units) and re-verified curl remained held at 7.76.1-31.el9 with versionlock file intact after restart

evidence.requirement: curl held at current version via versionlock
evidence.summary: Captured curl-7.76.1-31.el9 as installed version, installed versionlock plugin, and applied lock, confirmed in versionlock list

evidence.requirement: Update leaves curl at its current version (functional proof)
evidence.summary: Dry-run showed curl excluded from 207 pending updates; then a real dnf update -y (224 packages, incl. libcurl and new kernel) was executed to completion, and curl was confirmed still at 7.76.1-31.el9 afterward while libcurl upgraded to 7.76.1-40.el9_8.5

evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state and boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (82d4f0d1-...), uptime, systemctl is-system-running=running, and curl/versionlock state
systemctl reboot issued in background with disown; command returned 'reboot_issued' before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Node restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node offline during reboot); second poll returned a new boot_id (0e977b49-...), differing from baseline, proving an actual restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of services/data and curl hold persistence
evidence.summary: Confirmed new kernel running (5.14.0-687.42.1), system health reached 'running' with 0 failed units, and curl remained pinned at 7.76.1-31.el9 with the versionlock.list entry intact after reboot
